criteria.observation: At search start and each stale settlement, the latest query retains its correct busy, items and alert state without transient or extra notifications.
A current success preserves ordered results, and current failure or throw displays the specified safe error. Replacing visible content clears obsolete results and errors.
Replacing a request aborts its signal, and disposal silences that view. The other mounted view keeps its own signal and delivers its result. Snapshots remain isolated.
The submitted sequence of starts, settlements and closing agrees with the adapter’s actual notifications for one and two views.
